description: The external busy input in CONT_WAIT loses the contention round like any busy indication: back to LBT_WAIT, whose timer restarts with lbt_wait_dcd_ms when the input clears.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). The DTS keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue (C-1050). Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4 (prng.md 5): 45000 ms, then 12000 ms. channel_busy true at 40000 is a busy indication in CONT_WAIT (K-0006): the round is lost and csma.cont_wait is cancelled; the node waits in LBT_WAIT with csma.lbt_wait held (K-0089, K-0087). The external input clears at 41000 with no EOT prediction in force, so the idle is DCD-determined and the held timer takes lbt_wait_dcd_ms, 30000 ms (K-0006, K-0120). At 71000 its expiry starts CONT_WAIT with the second draw.
